_readme: Shares that arrived OUTSIDE the tradebook — IPO allotments, gifts, demat transfers.
A Zerodha tradebook export contains trades; an allotment is not one, so the shares show up in
your holdings with no matching row. Recording it here does two things: credits the cost to
EVERY twin book as a dated flow (so the twins get the same rupees to deploy their own way), and
gives REAL the actual lot so its FIFO cost basis and holding period are right.
cost_per_share = the ISSUE price you paid, not the listing price. That is the acquisition cost
under §48, and 'on' is the ALLOTMENT date, which is what §2(42A) counts the 12 months from.
Add an entry, then: uv run python scripts/twin.py daily
